name: Voctopus Sparse Voxel Octree
definition: A sparse voxel octree implementation in JavaScript/asm.js designed to be small and fast enough for direct shader rendering in WebGL without meshification, using ray tracing techniques.
summary: Voctopus is a sparse voxel octree implementation for WebGL ray tracing that uses compact pointer encoding in a flat memory layout to minimize footprint and enable high-performance traversal in JavaScript.
